cond_0001.intro: The purpose of this position is to support the Quality System needs of the Repair Services Division and provide a resource for developing and implementing good Quality practices while supporting the Division's overall business objectives.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Duties & Responsibilities include but are not limited to, the following:
Quality Auditing: Conduct In-Process operations audits and Quality System Audits of the Repairs Division to assure proper practices and verifications are being used. Support customer audits as required. Quality Improvement: Coordinate the Nonconformance & Corrective Action Processes. Collect, maintain & analyze Cost of Quality and Cost of EBIT data to help drive continuous improvement & resolve Quality problems. Initiate Quality Alerts and Technical Bulletins where applicable. Quality Management: Coordinate regular Quality/Management Reviews to review Division performance against goals/objectives – establish, implement, and track improvement priorities. Document Development & Control: Prepare, develop, & maintain needed work instructions/procedures & data/check sheets to support the expanding business. Supplier Management: Monitor Supplier Quality performance. Support the qualification of new Suppliers. Work with Key Suppliers to improve their Quality performance, where needed. Audit new & existing suppliers where needed. ISO 9001 Compliance: Maintain Repair Services ISO 9001 Quality Certification by assuring compliance with all applicable ISO 9001 requirements.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Engineering degree
5+ Years of related field experience (Power Industry – Steam/Gas Turbines)
Process knowledge in Power Industry; detailed knowledge & proficiency in Quality Systems – ISO requirements familiarity; Root Cause Analysis and Corrective/Preventive Action
Ability to identify, analyze, & solve Quality problems with practical solutions
Effective organizational and communication skills
Customer focused
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in current PC technology & effective use of software to create forms/documents
Ability to work effectively with minimum supervision – self starter
Ability to effectively perform & contribute in a team environment
Ability to effectively work with & accomplish multiple priorities
Provide technical guidance on Quality issues

Quality Improvement: Coordinate the Nonconformance & Corrective Action Processes. Collect, maintain & analyze Cost of Quality and Cost of EBIT data to help drive continuous improvement & resolve Quality problems. Initiate Quality Alerts and Technical Bulletins where applicable.

5+ Years of related field experience (Power Industry – Steam/Gas Turbines)

Duties & Responsibilities include but are not limited to, the following:
Quality Auditing: Conduct In-Process operations audits and Quality System Audits of the Repairs Division to assure proper practices and verifications are being used. Support customer audits as required. Quality Improvement: Coordinate the Nonconformance & Corrective Action Processes. Collect, maintain & analyze Cost of Quality and Cost of EBIT data to help drive continuous improvement & resolve Quality problems. Initiate Quality Alerts and Technical Bulletins where applicable. Quality Management: Coordinate regular Quality/Management Reviews to review Division performance against goals/objectives – establish, implement, and track improvement priorities. Document Development & Control: Prepare, develop, & maintain needed work instructions/procedures & data/check sheets to support the expanding business. Supplier Management: Monitor Supplier Quality performance. Support the qualification of new Suppliers. Work with Key Suppliers to improve their Quality performance, where needed. Audit new & existing suppliers where needed. ISO 9001 Compliance: Maintain Repair Services ISO 9001 Quality Certification by assuring compliance with all applicable ISO 9001 requirements.
cond_0327.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Engineering degree, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of related field experience in the Power Industry (Steam/Gas Turbines), or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of Quality Systems and ISO requirements.
Familiarity with Root Cause Analysis and Corrective/Preventive Action processes.
Comfort with current PC technology and ability to use software to create forms and documents.
Preferred Requirements
Background in process knowledge specific to the Power Industry.
Ability to work with minimal supervision and manage multiple priorities.
Willingness to contribute in a team environment and openness to feedback.
Ability to communicate effectively, both organizationally and with customers.
Ability to identify, analyze, and solve Quality problems with practical solutions.
Ability to provide technical guidance on Quality issues.

cond_0414.intro: The purpose of this position is to support the Quality System needs of the Repair Services Division and contribute to developing and implementing good Quality practices while supporting the Division's overall business objectives.
cond_0414.responsibilities:
Duties & Responsibilities include but are not limited to, the following:
Quality Auditing: Coordinate In-Process operations audits and Quality System Audits of the Repairs Division to help ensure proper practices and verifications are being used. Support customer audits as required.
Quality Improvement: Work with the team to coordinate the Nonconformance & Corrective Action Processes. Collect, maintain & analyze Cost of Quality and Cost of EBIT data to support continuous improvement & help resolve Quality problems. Initiate Quality Alerts and Technical Bulletins where applicable.
Quality Management: Coordinate regular Quality/Management Reviews to review Division performance against goals/objectives – work with stakeholders to establish, implement, and track improvement priorities.
Document Development & Control: Collaborate on preparing, developing, & maintaining needed work instructions/procedures & data/check sheets to support the expanding business.
Supplier Management: Monitor Supplier Quality performance. Support the qualification of new Suppliers. Work with Key Suppliers to help improve their Quality performance, where needed. Audit new & existing suppliers where needed.
ISO 9001 Compliance: Help maintain Repair Services ISO 9001 Quality Certification by working with the team to ensure compliance with all applicable ISO 9001 requirements.
cond_0414.requirements: Engineering degree. 5+ Years of related field experience (Power Industry – Steam/Gas Turbines). Process knowledge in Power Industry; detailed knowledge & proficiency in Quality Systems – ISO requirements familiarity; Root Cause Analysis and Corrective/Preventive Action; proficiency in current PC technology & effective use of software to create forms/documents. Ability to work effectively with minimum supervision – self starter; Ability to effectively perform & contribute in a team environment; Ability to effectively work with & accomplish multiple priorities; Effective organizational and communication skills; Customer focused; Ability to identify, analyze, & solve Quality problems with practical solutions; Provide technical guidance on Quality issues.

The purpose of this position is to support the Quality System needs of the Repair Services Division and provide a resource for developing and implementing good Quality practices while supporting the Division's overall business objectives.
cond_0429.responsibilities:
Duties & Responsibilities include but are not limited to, the following:
Quality Auditing: Conduct In-Process operations audits and Quality System Audits of the Repairs Division to assure proper practices and verifications are being used. Stay in regular contact with customers to support their audits as required.
Quality Improvement: Coordinate the Nonconformance & Corrective Action Processes. Collect, maintain & analyze Cost of Quality and Cost of EBIT data to help drive continuous improvement & resolve Quality problems. Initiate Quality Alerts and Technical Bulletins where applicable.
Quality Management: Coordinate regular Quality/Management Reviews to review Division performance against goals/objectives – establish, implement, and track improvement priorities. Actively contribute in these reviews by walking stakeholders through performance data and raising issues early.
Document Development & Control: Prepare, develop, & maintain needed work instructions/procedures & data/check sheets to support the expanding business.
Supplier Management: Stay in ongoing contact with suppliers to monitor their Quality performance. Support the qualification of new Suppliers. Work directly with Key Suppliers to improve their Quality performance, where needed. Audit new & existing suppliers where needed.
ISO 9001 Compliance: Maintain Repair Services ISO 9001 Quality Certification by assuring compliance with all applicable ISO 9001 requirements.
cond_0429.requirements: Engineering degree. 5+ Years of related field experience (Power Industry – Steam/Gas Turbines). Process knowledge in Power Industry; detailed knowledge & proficiency in Quality Systems – ISO requirements familiarity; Root Cause Analysis and Corrective/Preventive Action; proficiency in current PC technology & effective use of software to create forms/documents. Ability to work effectively with minimum supervision – self starter; Ability to effectively perform & contribute in a team environment, including speaking up and initiating discussions to resolve issues; Ability to effectively work with & accomplish multiple priorities; Effective organizational and communication skills; Customer focused; Ability to identify, analyze, & solve Quality problems with practical solutions; Provide technical guidance on Quality issues, including explaining trade-offs and handling questions from stakeholders clearly.
cond_0429.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

The purpose of this position is to support the Quality System needs of the Repair Services Division and provide a resource for developing and implementing good Quality practices while supporting the Division's overall business objectives.
cond_0528.responsibilities:
Duties & Responsibilities include but are not limited to, the following:
Quality Auditing: Conduct In-Process operations audits and Quality System Audits of the Repairs Division to assure proper practices and verifications are being used. Stay in regular contact with customers to support their audits as required.
Quality Improvement: Coordinate the Nonconformance & Corrective Action Processes. Collect, maintain & analyze Cost of Quality and Cost of EBIT data to help drive continuous improvement & resolve Quality problems. Initiate Quality Alerts and Technical Bulletins where applicable.
Quality Management: Coordinate regular Quality/Management Reviews to review Division performance against goals/objectives – establish, implement, and track improvement priorities. A regular part of this role is bringing people together to clarify priorities and walk stakeholders through performance results.
Document Development & Control: Prepare, develop, & maintain needed work instructions/procedures & data/check sheets to support the expanding business.
Supplier Management: Stay in ongoing contact with suppliers to monitor their Quality performance. Support the qualification of new Suppliers. Work directly with Key Suppliers to improve their Quality performance where needed. Audit new & existing suppliers where needed.
ISO 9001 Compliance: Maintain Repair Services ISO 9001 Quality Certification by assuring compliance with all applicable ISO 9001 requirements.
cond_0528.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Engineering degree
5+ Years of related field experience (Power Industry – Steam/Gas Turbines)
Process knowledge in Power Industry; detailed knowledge & proficiency in Quality Systems – ISO requirements familiarity
Root Cause Analysis and Corrective/Preventive Action
Ability to identify, analyze, & solve Quality problems with practical solutions
Effective organizational and communication skills; able to explain trade-offs and handle questions from stakeholders clearly
Ability to work effectively with minimum supervision – self starter
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in current PC technology & effective use of software to create forms/documents
Ability to effectively perform & contribute in a team environment, actively engaging with colleagues to resolve issues
Ability to effectively work with & accomplish multiple priorities
Customer focused
Ability to provide technical guidance on Quality issues

cond_0555.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
The purpose of this position is to support the Quality System needs of the Repair Services Division and provide a resource for developing and implementing good Quality practices while supporting the Division's overall business objectives.
cond_0555.responsibilities:
Duties & Responsibilities include but are not limited to, the following:
Quality Auditing: Conduct In-Process operations audits and Quality System Audits of the Repairs Division to assure proper practices and verifications are being used. Stay in regular contact with customers to support their audits as required.
Quality Improvement: Coordinate the Nonconformance & Corrective Action Processes. Collect, maintain & analyze Cost of Quality and Cost of EBIT data to help drive continuous improvement & resolve Quality problems. Initiate Quality Alerts and Technical Bulletins where applicable.
Quality Management: Coordinate regular Quality/Management Reviews to review Division performance against goals/objectives – establish, implement, and track improvement priorities. Actively contribute in these reviews by walking stakeholders through performance data and raising issues early.
Document Development & Control: Prepare, develop, & maintain needed work instructions/procedures & data/check sheets to support the expanding business.
Supplier Management: Stay in ongoing contact with suppliers to monitor their Quality performance. Support the qualification of new Suppliers. Work directly with Key Suppliers to improve their Quality performance, where needed. Audit new & existing suppliers where needed.
ISO 9001 Compliance: Maintain Repair Services ISO 9001 Quality Certification by assuring compliance with all applicable ISO 9001 requirements.
cond_0555.requirements: Engineering degree. 5+ Years of related field experience (Power Industry – Steam/Gas Turbines). Process knowledge in Power Industry; detailed knowledge & proficiency in Quality Systems – ISO requirements familiarity; Root Cause Analysis and Corrective/Preventive Action; proficiency in current PC technology & effective use of software to create forms/documents. Ability to work effectively with minimum supervision – self starter; Ability to effectively perform & contribute in a team environment, including speaking up and initiating discussions to resolve issues; Ability to effectively work with & accomplish multiple priorities; Effective organizational and communication skills; Customer focused; Ability to identify, analyze, & solve Quality problems with practical solutions; Provide technical guidance on Quality issues, including explaining trade-offs and handling questions from stakeholders clearly.

Quality Auditing: Conduct In-Process operations audits and Quality System Audits of the Repairs Division to assure proper practices and verifications are being used. Stay in regular contact with customers to support their audits as required.
Quality Improvement: Coordinate the Nonconformance & Corrective Action Processes. Collect, maintain & analyze Cost of Quality and Cost of EBIT data to help drive continuous improvement & resolve Quality problems. Initiate Quality Alerts and Technical Bulletins where applicable.
Quality Management: Coordinate regular Quality/Management Reviews to review Division performance against goals/objectives – establish, implement, and track improvement priorities. A regular part of this role is bringing people together to clarify priorities and walk stakeholders through performance results.
Document Development & Control: Prepare, develop, & maintain needed work instructions/procedures & data/check sheets to support the expanding business.
Supplier Management: Stay in ongoing contact with suppliers to monitor their Quality performance. Support the qualification of new Suppliers. Work directly with Key Suppliers to improve their Quality performance where needed. Audit new & existing suppliers where needed.
ISO 9001 Compliance: Maintain Repair Services ISO 9001 Quality Certification by assuring compliance with all applicable ISO 9001 requirements.
cond_0636.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Engineering degree
5+ Years of related field experience (Power Industry – Steam/Gas Turbines)
Process knowledge in Power Industry; detailed knowledge & proficiency in Quality Systems – ISO requirements familiarity
Root Cause Analysis and Corrective/Preventive Action
Ability to identify, analyze, & solve Quality problems with practical solutions
Effective organizational and communication skills; able to explain trade-offs and handle questions from stakeholders clearly
Ability to work effectively with minimum supervision – self starter
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in current PC technology & effective use of software to create forms/documents
Ability to effectively perform & contribute in a team environment, actively engaging with colleagues to resolve issues
Ability to effectively work with & accomplish multiple priorities
Customer focused
Ability to provide technical guidance on Quality issues
